chapter: Postwar: Chicago, Vinson, Hines and Cootie
title: The Woodside Hotel and Jesse Miller's band at the DeLisa
summary: Back in New York and then Chicago he substituted for Red Saunders at the DeLisa with Jesse Miller's show band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: You'd never stayed in New York before, had you, except when you went with McShann?
No, I was living there when I came down with Jay. We were staying there at the Woodside Hotel.
The old Woodside, that was it.
So back you went to New York.
We went back to New York.
Did you stay uptown? Did you go uptown?
Because this must have been '45, spring of '45 that you -- let's see, you joined the Jesse Miller band in Chicago in the spring of '45.
How did you get that? How did that happen?
I happened to be in Chicago. I went there, my wife and I and my baby. That was my oldest girl.
She's in California, in Santa Monica. She lives there.
Is she? Oh, that's why you went and visited, huh?
So we went to Chicago and I was staying with my mother.
Oh, yeah. They were still there.
And I was hanging around there, and I found out he needed a drummer. Somebody told him that I was in town, and he was going in the DeLisa Club.
Oh, I remember in love with the DeLisa, yeah.
See, I lived in Chicago for some time, too.
See, Red Saunders had the band in the DeLisa all the time.
So Red was taking his vacation.
And Jesse Miller was taking a band in there to replace Red while he was on his vacation.
So that's when I played with Jesse Miller.
No kidding. Was it a good band?
Oh, a very good band. You know, it was a show band.
Anybody in it that you can --
Well, a lot of the guys played -- some played with Earl Hines.
anybody like that? [Schaffner] was in it? Bob Schaffner or I heard Bob Schaffner down there.
You know, Jesse played with Earl Hines. He was the one that sounded more like Louis. Little Jesse Miller.
Yeah. Did you enjoy staying in Chicago?
So I stayed with him until he left the DeLisa, then Red Saunders came in again.
From off his vacation, you see. He took about two months off on his vacation, I think.
